14machans: Roland Machans signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-C1 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
dank.ricefarmer: Severin Ricefarmer told the sergeant he was a tailor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
A patient at the aid post asked Severin Ricefarmer for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen.

The patient has added a stove and three chairs to the kitchen drawing. Severin Ricefarmer asks about each detail while changing the dressing. A letter from home found Severin Ricefarmer before the night shift. Severin Ricefarmer folded it small and kept it close. The transfer made Severin Ricefarmer a runner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
darth._.vicious: Otto "Parson" Vicious reported to S-S5 with a frozen apple sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Otto "Parson" Vicious checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again.
Otto "Parson" Vicious tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Millbank. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
A parcel came for Otto "Parson" Vicious that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
highspeed_nodrag1833: Bastian Nodrag introduced himself as a tailor from Oakmere. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
A bullet went through Bastian Nodrag's sleeve at R-F3 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Ulrich Unstoppable of the Hegemony (@mr.unstoppable213).

Bastian Nodrag's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Bastian Nodrag wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Bastian Nodrag lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Bastian Nodrag tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Bastian Nodrag pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Bastian Nodrag put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.
lebronmygoat25: At the depot, Quentin Lebronmygoat had practised answering to his name. At R-S10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A shell hit the latrine at R-S10. Nobody was hurt. Quentin Lebronmygoat says it was the best day of the war. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Quentin Lebronmygoat did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Quentin Lebronmygoat passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it.
Quentin Lebronmygoat noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down what changed.
A note came over the wire at Lantern Hill, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Quentin Lebronmygoat.' Edmund Callmequeeno sang louder.
The men have learned that Quentin Lebronmygoat is always the first one awake. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.
sovietkitten1: Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten came up with a draft of replacements on Day 7. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a woman in a white dress, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a lock of hair in a matchbox. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.
